== Summary ==
[[Tom Haid]] (5th place) with his crystal award in front of the Players Committee banner. Taken at the [[2021 World Championship]] (the Hyatt Regency Crystal City, Arlington, Virginia, 8–10 October 2021).

'''Identification:''' Identified by matching his face (blond spiked hair, features) to his place in [[:File:2021 World Championship Top 8.jpg]] (third standing from left; wrap-up caption) and [[:File:Tom Haid 2021 World Championship.jpg]]; he wears a different shirt (Rebel Alliance logo T-shirt) here, so the match rests on the face.

* '''Event:''' [[2021 World Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2021-10-31
